title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether the People's Courts Shall Accept Civil Lawsuits Filed by Victims of Criminal Cases for Compensation for Mental Distress

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2002] No. 17
Yunnan Provincial Higher People's Court:
We have received your court's Yun Gao Fa [2001] No. 176, the "Request for Instructions on Whether the People's Courts Shall Accept a Civil Action for Mental Damages Independently Filed by a Victim in Respect of a Criminal Act". Upon our review, we reply as follows:
Pursuant to Article 36 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 77 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, as well as Article 1, Paragraph 2 of our court's "Provisions on the Scope of Incidental Civil Actions in Criminal Cases", in respect of an incidental civil action filed by a victim of a criminal case for mental damages suffered as a result of the defendant's criminal act, or a separate civil action for compensation for mental damages filed by the victim after the conclusion of that criminal case, the People's Courts shall not accept such action.
Thus, we reply.
July 15, 2002
